none: PAS WMID-D7C456: Roman silver republican denarius
contea di ritrovamento: Staffordshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A silver Roman republican denarius of C Vibius CF CN Pansa Caetronianus, dating from 48 BC. The obverse depicts a mask of Pan facing right, with the legend PANSA below. The reverse depicts Jupiter Axurus seated left with the legend C. VIBIVS C.F.C.N behind and IOVIS AXVR before, though the latter part of the legend is illegible.
